evidence.note: Extends parallel test-time scaling to latent reasoning models (which reason in continuous hidden-state vectors rather than tokens) by introducing two stochastic sampling strategies (Monte Carlo Dropout, Additive Gaussian Noise) to generate diverse latent trajectories and a Latent Reward Model trained with a step-wise contrastive objective to score and aggregate them, showing consistent scaling gains with best-of-N and beam search across three arithmetic benchmarks and backbones up to 4B parameters.
evidence.title: Parallel Test-Time Scaling for Latent Reasoning Models
